chunks.text: Our cables and wires business grew volume by about 20% this quarter. Capacity utilisation across our plants is now around 75 to 80 percent, and the new Halol expansion will come on stream in Q4.
On margins, we continue to guide for wires and cables EBITDA margin in the 11 to 13 percent band. This quarter we delivered 13.4 percent helped by a favourable product mix and lower ad spends.
FMEG turned EBITDA positive at 0.6 percent. Fans and lights saw good traction; switchgear remains under pressure from pricing.
Exports contributed 7.1 percent of revenue. We have built a presence in the US and Middle East and expect exports to grow faster than domestic, though the 10 percent target may take longer.
Working capital days increased slightly due to higher inventory of copper ahead of the season. We expect net working capital to normalise by year end.
Capex for FY27 will be in the range of 1,000 to 1,100 crore, largely towards cables capacity including extra high voltage cables.
